dedupe_keys.name: accurate path loss modeling and angular temporal characterization of outdoor mmwave channels across multi frequency bands in 5g mobile network

description: Ali Alsahlany publishes Python and 3D-environment files for outdoor 5G millimetre-wave ray tracing. Zenodo provides code text and three Istanbul urban environment archives under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies Sionna-based simulations at 28, 38, 66, 71 and 90 GHz for an ITU campus, Aksaray Metro Station street and Sultan Ahmet Square. Outputs include path loss, excess delay, delay spread and angle of arrival. This model can compare cell-placement or radio-link assumptions in urban telecom scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these five-band Istanbul runs. Coverage is three modelled environments, not measured coverage across the city. A limitation is that the 3D maps used a premium Blender-OSM add-on and efficient execution is said to need a GPU; upstream map rights and exact replication environment need checking. Ray-tracing predictions are not field measurements. No archive was downloaded, and no path-loss result was recalculated.
